threat_event: Information-stealing malware on the main laptop takes saved passwords and session tokens, which are used to sign in to the Client A contractor portal and the email suite
threat_source: Cybercriminal (phishing or a fake software update)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Daily work in an administrator account; browser stores the Client A portal password; email MFA by text message; no security training beyond Client A modules
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 main laptop; SYS-06 Client A portal; SYS-01 email and files
regulatory_driver: C-NUCLEAR-S01 (CSR-A (4)-(5)); C-NUCLEAR-R01 (73.54 program terms in CSR-A)
existing_controls: Disk encryption; automatic updates; built-in antivirus; Client A enforces MFA on its portal
treatment_plan: Standard daily account; password manager and no browser-saved passwords; authenticator-app MFA on email; annual security course; P08 runbook walked through before the fall outage

threat_event: Client B Part 37 security information (security plan, approved-individuals list, 2025 review report describing uncorrected weaknesses) is opened by someone who should not see it
threat_source: Owner error; anyone holding the link; AI service provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Report shared by an "anyone with the link" link for 13 months; plan and list received by email and synced to the laptop; one paragraph pasted into a consumer AI chat assistant; no rule on where client security information may live
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 email and files; Client B security information (BP-02)
existing_controls: Link turned off and copies deleted 2026-07-21; Client B told 2026-07-22
treatment_plan: Keep Client B security information only in Client B's share; named-person sharing only and a monthly sharing report; no client text in any AI tool; ask Client B whether it needs anything more for its own records

threat_event: Takeover of the email and file suite account through a phished text message code or a SIM swap
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA by text message only; client report drafts and Client A correspondence in the suite
treatment_plan: Authenticator-app MFA with offline recovery codes; carrier account PIN against SIM swap; monthly sign-in review (POL-01 7.7)

threat_event: Malware on the owner's USB drive or field laptop is carried to Client A and reaches a plant digital asset (attempted pivot)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One unencrypted personal drive used on the internet-connected field laptop, the main laptop, other clients' sites, and Client A workstations
affected_asset_or_process: Client A plant digital assets; USB drive; SYS-04
regulatory_driver: C-NUCLEAR-S01 (CSR-A (1)-(2)); C-NUCLEAR-R01 (73.54 program terms in CSR-A)
existing_controls: Client A kiosk scan before each use (kiosk slips kept); company devices never connected to plant networks
treatment_plan: Encrypted drive used only for Client A, wiped after each outage; field laptop kept offline; data moves to Client A only after a kiosk scan

threat_event: Malware on the unsupported field laptop alters or corrupts survey meter data before it reaches a client report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported operating system; antivirus no longer updated; joins home Wi-Fi to email data files
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 field laptop; survey data (BP-01, BP-04)
existing_controls: Readings also written in the field notebook; reports cross-checked against notebook values
treatment_plan: Take the field laptop off all networks now; replace it or the operating system with a supported one that runs the meter software

threat_event: Raw survey data or report drafts are lost to device failure, ransomware, or an account lockout with no usable backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup of the field laptop or USB drive; suite version history only 30 days; no copy outside the suite account
existing_controls: Suite sync and 30-day version history for the main laptop
treatment_plan: Copy field data to the suite the same day; monthly encrypted export kept in the locked cabinet; test one restore each quarter

threat_event: Client A information is kept beyond contract terms or in a personal account (fall 2025 work packages never returned; permit photos synced to a personal photo cloud)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No register of client information or return dates; photo cloud sync on
affected_asset_or_process: Client A information; SYS-03 phone; paper cabinet
treatment_plan: Register of client information with return dates; destroy or return the 2025 packages with a written certificate; turn off sync and move permit photos to the Client A portal

threat_event: Safeguards Information is sent to the owner by mistake and cannot be protected as 10 CFR 73.22 requires
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No locked security storage container; no SGI-approved computer; no rule for inadvertent receipt before POL-01
existing_controls: CSR-A says SGI is never sent to contractors; none found in the 2026-07-21 search
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. POL-01 8.4 (do not copy or forward; keep in personal custody; call Client A at once) adopted 2026-08-31

threat_event: The AI drift prediction feature shares site-tagged readings with its vendor, and its predictions are used to stretch instrument checks
threat_source: Service provider; owner reliance on the model
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature turned on 2026-05-18 without review; readings tagged with client site, building, and room; no rule on how predictions may be used
existing_controls: Annual calibration by the laboratory continues regardless of predictions
treatment_plan: Remove site tags; confirm the vendor's data use terms; predictions may only bring checks forward, never push calibration or response checks back (P10)

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable (illness or injury) or loses the only phone during an outage, so contract work and notices stop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; both second factors on one phone; no coverage agreement
existing_controls: Client A can cover outage work with its own staff
treatment_plan: Peer coverage agreement with Client A's consent; sealed recovery codes and contact sheet with the owner's attorney; per-diem technician script (P05)

threat_event: Takeover of the accounting SaaS leads to invoice or bank-detail fraud and exposure of the technician's W-9
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA; password reused on instrument vendor portals
existing_controls: Bank requires its own MFA for payments
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA; unique password in a password manager; confirm any bank-detail change by phone

threat_event: A household device or a nearby attacker on the home network attacks the laptops or the router
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Household devices share the Wi-Fi; router administrator password was the default
existing_controls: Router and host firewalls on; all business traffic uses TLS
treatment_plan: Default router password changed 2026-07-23; separate business wireless network

threat_event: A suspected incident is not recognized, or the 8-hour Client A or 24-hour Client B notice is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan or contact list before 2026-08-31; the AI paste was reported to Client B six weeks late
regulatory_driver: C-NUCLEAR-S01 (CSR-A (5)); C-NUCLEAR-S04 (CSIA-B (4)); C-NUCLEAR-R03 (feeds Client A's 73.77 clocks)
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook; printed contact list in the field bag and at home; walk through before the fall outage

threat_event: A hurricane closes the home office for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single office; paper and devices on site
existing_controls: Suite and client portals reachable from anywhere over a phone hotspot
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Take the laptop, field kit, and printed contacts when a storm watch is issued

threat_event: The phone is lost or stolen, exposing permit photos and texts and locking the owner out of the second factors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Both second factors on one phone; permit photos in the camera roll
treatment_plan: Remote wipe on; recovery codes sealed offline; permit photos moved to the Client A portal
